verses: Qasam hai sitaray ki jab woh giray
Kay tumharay sathi ney na raah gumm ki hai na woh tairhi raah per hai
Aur na woh apni khuwahish say koi baat kehtay hain
Woh to sirf wahee hai jo utari jati hai
Ussay poori taqat walay farishtay ney sikhaya hai
Jo zor aawar hai phir woh seedha khara ho gaya
Aur woh buland aasman kay kinaron per tha
Phir nazdeek hua aur utar aaya
Pus woh do kamanon kay ba-qadar fasla reh gaya balkay)yeh uss say bhi kum
Pus uss ney Allah kay banday ko wahee phonchaee jo bhi phonchaee
Dil ney jhoot nahi kaha jissay (payghumbar ney) dekha
Kiya tum jhagra kertay ho uss per jo (payghumbar) dekhtay hain
Ussay to aik martaba aur bhi dekha tha
Sidrat-ul-muntaha kay pass
Ussi kay pass jannat ul-mawa hai
Jab kay sidrah ko chupaye leti thi woh cheez jo uss per cha rahi thi
Na to nigah behki na hadd say barhi
Yaqeenan uss ney apney rab ki bari bari nishaniyon mein say baaz nishaniyan dekh len
Kiya tum ney laat aur uzza ko dekha
Aur manaat teesray pichlay ko
Kiya tumharay liye larkay aur Allah kay liye larkiyan hain?
Yeh to abb bari beyinsafi ki taqseem hai

Dar-asal yeh sirf naam hain jo tum ney aur tumharay baap dadon ney unn kay rakh liye hain Allah ney unn ki koi daleel nahi utari. Yeh log to sirf atkal kay aur apni nafsani khuwaishon kay peechay paray huye hain. Aur yaqeenan unn kay rab ki taraf say unn kay pass hidayat aa chuki hai
Kiya her shakhs jo aarzoo keray ussay mayassar hai?
Allah hi kay hath hai yeh jahaan aur woh jahaan
Aur boht say farishtay aasmano mein hain jin ki sifarish kuch bhi nafa nahi dey sakti magar yeh aur baat hai kay Allah Taalaa apni khushi aur apni chahat say jiss kay liye chahaye ijazat dey dey
Be-shak jo log aakhirat per eman nahi rakhtay woh farishton ka zanana naam muqarrar kertay hain
Halankay unhen uss ka koi ilm nahi woh sirf apney guman kay peechay paray huye hain aur be-shak wahm (o guman) haq kay muqablay mein kuch kaam nahi deta
To aap uss say mun mor len jo humari yaad say mun moray aur jin ka iradah ba-juz zindagani duniya kay aur kuch na ho
Yehi unn kay ilm ki inteha hai. Aap ka rab uss say khoob waqif hai jo uss ki raah say bhatak gaya hai aur o hi khoob waqif hai uss say bhi jo raah yafta hai

Aur Allah hi ka hai jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zamin mein hai takay Allah Taalaa buray amal kerney walon ko unn kay aemaal ka badla dey aur nek kaam kerney walon ko acha badla inayat farmaye

Unn logon ko jo baray gunahon say bachtay hain aur bey hayaee say bhi. Siwaye kissi chotay say gunah kay. Be-shak tera rab boht kushadah maghfirat wala hai, woh tumhen bakhoobi janta hai jabkay uss ney tumhen zamin say peda kiya aur jabkay tum apni maaon kay pet mein bachay thay. Pus tum apni pakeezgi aap biyan na kero, o hi perhezgaron ko khoob janta hai
Kiya aap ney ussay dekha jiss ney mun mor liya
Aur boht kum diya aur hath rok liya
Kiya ussay ilm ghaib hai kay woh (sab kuch) dekh raha hai?
Kiya ussay uss cheez ki khabar nahi di gaee jo Musa (alaihi as-salam) kay
Aur wafadaar Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) kay saheefon mein tha
Kay koi shakhs kissi doosray ka bojh na uthaye ga
Aur yeh kay her insan kay liye sirf o hi hai jiss ki koshish khud uss ney ki
Aur yeh kay be-shak uss ki koshish unqareeb dekhi jaye gi
Phir ussay poora poora badla diya jaye ga
Aur yeh kay aap kay rab hi ki taraf phonchna hai
Aur yeh kay o hi hansata hai aur o hi rulata hai
Aur yeh kay o hi maarta hai aur jilata hai
Aur yeh kay ussi ney jora yani nurr madah peda kiya hai
Nutfay say jabkay woh tapkaya jata hai
Aur yeh kay ussi kay zimmay doobara peda kerna hai
Aur yeh kay o hi maaldaar banata hai aur sarmaya deta hai
Aur yeh kay o hi sheyara (sitaray) ka rab hai
Aur yeh kay uss ney aad awwal ko halak kiya hai
Aur samood ko bhi (jin mein say) aik ko bhi baqi na rakha
Aur uss say pehlay qom Nooh ko, yaqeenan woh baray zalim aur sirkash thay
Aur motafiqa (shehar ya ulti hui bastiyon ko) ussi ney ulat diya
Phir uss per cha diya jo chaya
Pus aey insan to apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat kay baray mein jhagray ga?
Yeh (nabi) daraney walay hain pehlay daraney walon mein say
Aaney wali ghari qareeb aa gaee hai
Allah kay siwa uss ka (waqt moyyen per khol) dikhaney wala aur koi nahi
Pus kiya tum uss baat say tajjub kertay ho
Aur hans rahey ho? Rotay nahi?
(balkay)yeh) tum khel rahey ho
Abb Allah kay samney sajday kero aur (ussi) ki ibadat kero
